|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、タスケン・レイダーに配備する。起動にフォースを必要としない。その場で戦闘が始まった場合、即座に運命数を２枚引く。２枚の運命数の合計＞５ならば、敵は武器を“はじき飛ばされて”、この戦闘では使えなくなる。</span>
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">“ガッフィ”とも呼ばれる、タスケン・レイダーの好む武器。廃棄された金属などで作られる。相手を脅し、恐怖させるに十分な武器である。</span>''
|translation='''Title:''' Gaderffii staff.

'''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy on a Tusken Raider. No Force is required to activate it. If a battle begins there, immediately draw two destiny. If their total is greater than 5, the enemy's weapons are ‘knocked away’ and cannot be used in this battle.

'''Lore:''' A weapon favored by Tusken Raiders, also called a ‘gaffi.’ Made from discarded metal and similar materials, it is sufficient to threaten and frighten an opponent.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says activating it requires no Force; the English says it may target for free. The Japanese describes a battle beginning there, while the English says a battle has just been initiated where the weapon is present.
